case_name: Shikha Jain vs The State Of Uttar Pradesh
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
INHERENT JURISDICTION

 REVIEW PETITION (CRL.) NO.395 OF 2021
 CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.731 OF 2021

 Shikha Jain …Petitioner(s)

 versus
 The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr. …Respondent(s)

 O R D E R
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case on record and in

 keeping with the spirit of settlement that was earlier arrived at, the relief was

 granted.
We have gone through the grounds taken in Review Petition and do

 not find any error apparent to justify interference. This Review Petition is

 dismissed.
………………………J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]

November 16, 2021.
